items.root_cause: The band audit's ratchet has two states, backlog and NEW, and nothing between them: the backlog grows only by a reviewed -Accept, and the worklist that is meant to decide band rows read only the backlog. So every row captured after 2026-09-22 that the derived band refuses re-pages on every run forever, while sitting on no docket. The other four matching detectors were moved to page-once-then-worklist in plan-2026-09-22-9; the band kind was left on the old whole-set page.

root_fix.what: a band-refused row outside the backlog pages once, on its first day, and then waits on the matching worklist until -Decide settles it, the pattern the other matching detectors use since plan-2026-09-22-9. Nothing is weakened: every unexplained row is still counted, printed and listed.
root_fix.exact_change: audit-band-refusals.ps1: Get-TcBandOpenRows keeps first_seen per key (id|store|name) in grocery/out/band-refusals-open.json, drops a key with a match-verdicts.json verdict on band|key, prints UNEXPLAINED (and exits 2) only for rows first seen today and OPEN for older ones; new -OpenFile and -VerdictFile parameters. match-worklist-lib.ps1 Read-MatchFindings: reads band-refusals-open.json as kind band beside the backlog.
